title: Lukiškės Square candle-lighting action
location: Reported lead: Lukiškės Square, Vilnius. The retrospective text describes people at the square, but site-specific concurrent attendance and the relation to the January 9 call remain unverified.
scope: The account describes individual or pair candle-lighting, while its multicity list does not establish a single simultaneous national gathering or a Vilnius-specific crowd size.
organizer: Nacionalinis susivienijimas Vilnius branch issued a prospective call on January 9; whether it organized or mobilized the people later described is unverified.
participants_original: The retrospective account says “many people” went to Lukiškės Square late Tuesday and describes people arriving alone, in pairs, or with children; it then lists several Lithuanian towns without city-level counts.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. “Many people” is not a defensible threshold count; the multicity caption does not isolate concurrent Vilnius attendance. No photographs were counted.

start_date.summary: The retrospective article in the January issue describes people going to Lukiškės Square late Tuesday, January 12; this is the reported physical-action date, not the January 9 announcement date.

location.summary: The retrospective text identifies Lukiškės Square; the January 9 prospective call specifically names Vilnius. The multicity caption does not by itself isolate each site/date or concurrent attendance, and the link to actual attendees remains unverified.

organizer.summary: The Vilnius branch called for candle-lighting, but the available evidence does not establish that actual attendees were mobilized by or represented the branch.

demands.summary: The prospective call connects candles to opposition to perceived obstruction of the square becoming a representative state square; no evidence links that political demand to the actual January 12 attendees, so no demand category is assigned.

participants_original.summary: Retrospective wording is “many people”; it describes individuals/pairs and lists multiple cities without a count or a Vilnius-specific estimate.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Available wording and multicity listing do not establish 50 people concurrently at Vilnius or at any one site.

end_date.summary: No physical end is reported. The known description of activity is not used to infer closure.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; the source does not provide event-specific violence evidence.

state_response.summary: All seven response fields remain unknown; silence is not coded as no response.

notes: Retain as a reported physical-action lead; confirmation of Vilnius attendance and whether this was an organized public gathering remain pending. The retrospective narrative supplies January 12; its multicity caption alone does not identify each city’s date or attendance. The January 9 call is prospective and explicitly asks people not to gather; the retrospective account does not show that attendees shared its policy framing. Do not label it a sit-in or automatically treat commemorative candles as a protest. No photographs counted.
open_questions: Was there a qualifying public gathering of 50 or more people concurrently at Lukiškės Square?
Did attendees mobilize around the square’s policy status, or was the event solely commemorative?
Can a contemporaneous report independently establish the physical date, actual Vilnius attendance, organizer link, or action end?
Did activity at any other listed town form a distinct local action or part of one coordinated event?
